data.body: Review-plan run 5 BLOCK (3), all on import: the claim that import never heals mid-run was false. Its pass-2b/2e writes go through the already-wrapped append_event/transition_core and the close refresh. Corrected: a mid-run heal keeps the import's commits (the override replays fresh unpushed events byte-identically). Only a clone already holding an unpushed event older than the reclaim horizon replays nothing (ADR 0106 section 5 accepted loss, backup ref kept). Plan v7: import heals before its reads (not on --dry-run) and heal-and-retries at _flush. The reconciler aborts (RESCHEDULE) on any remaining write-blocking divergence, not only an unhealed supersession. Each heal-failure refusal names DIVERGED and says the condition is transient. claim --review covered. AC unchanged.
